Messages.Author: Cody Laux
Messages.Body:
Can a sudden reversal be used to destroy a master card already in play,
or just as it is being "cast"?
Cody

Messages.Author: Thomas R Wylie
Messages.Body:
Sudden Reversal can only be used immediately after a master card is
played, to burn that master card and undo its effect.

Tom Wylie rec.games.trading-cards.* Network Representative for
aa...@cats.ucsc.edu Wizards of the Coast, Inc.
